# RandomPokemon.xyz

> RandomPokemon.xyz is a free, independent, unofficial fan-made random Pokémon picker and team generator covering the 1,025 main species from Generations 1–9.

## Main generators

- [Random Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/): Generate 1–6 Pokémon, apply filters, lock and reroll members, inspect team weaknesses, save locally, and share a seeded result.
- [Starter Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-pokemon-starter-generator): Pick from traditional Grass, Fire, and Water starters, with optional Pikachu and Eevee.
- [Legendary Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-pokemon-legendary-generator): Select from Pokémon classified as Legendary.
- [Shiny Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-shiny-pokemon-generator): Select a species with shiny artwork enabled; this does not simulate in-game shiny odds.
- [Nuzlocke Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-nuzlocke-pokemon-generator): Create a game-agnostic, reproducible custom encounter rule.
- [Kanto Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/kanto-pokemon-generator): Generate from Generation 1 species #001–151.
- [Paldea Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/paldea-pokemon-generator): Generate from Generation 9 species #906–1025.

## Pokédex and collections

- [Pokémon Pokédex](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon): Search the Generation 1–9 Pokédex and open species profiles with normal and Shiny artwork, types, abilities, stats, and evolution details.
- [Shiny Pokémon Pokédex](https://randompokemon.xyz/shiny-pokemon): Compare normal and Shiny artwork for all 1,025 main species. This is an artwork directory, not a Shiny-odds simulator.
- [Legendary Pokémon List](https://randompokemon.xyz/legendary-pokemon): Browse Pokémon classified as Legendary by generation; Mythical Pokémon are kept separate.
- [Starter Pokémon List](https://randompokemon.xyz/starter-pokemon): Browse the 27 traditional Grass, Fire, and Water first partners from Generations 1–9.

## Starter guides

- [Generation 5 Starter Pokémon](https://randompokemon.xyz/starter-pokemon/gen-5): Compare Snivy, Tepig, and Oshawott, including Shiny forms and evolution families.
- [Pokémon X and Y Starters](https://randompokemon.xyz/starter-pokemon/pokemon-x-y): Compare Chespin, Fennekin, and Froakie, including Shiny forms and evolution families.

## Data notes

- Species and battle data are normalized from the open-source @pkmn data ecosystem.
- Height and English species-category metadata come from PokéAPI.
- Default sprites come from the PokéAPI sprites repository; supported alternate forms may use Pokémon Showdown sprites.
- The Pokédex contains 1,025 default species plus supported alternate forms. Featured profiles above are the current priority indexable detail pages; other valid species URLs may be crawlable but are marked noindex while their content is expanded.
- The site does not provide game-specific encounter tables, movesets, levels, or competitive team recommendations.
